title: 弓を引く
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: ONE original square pose preview for an art studio website. Create one finished detailed gouache/anime illustration of ONE clothed young adult with medium tousled brown hair, natural facial features, cream long sleeve shirt with rolled cuffs, loose indigo trousers, pale sneakers. Plain pale ivory studio backdrop with soft warm natural shading. Natural face, fingers, joints, dimensional clothing folds, broad gender neutral styling. Whole body including both feet completely visible, character and necessary prop large about 80%canvas, clear action readable as small UI thumbnail. Single distinct image, NOT stick figure, NOT schematic, NOT flat icon, NOT contact sheet. No text, labels, diagram arrows, logos, grid, border, fancy costumes, brands or watermark. Action: An archer drawing ONE plain wooden bow in side three-quarter view, feet firmly spread sideways. LEFT ARM holds bow forward, left fingers around its grip; RIGHT ELBOW pulled backward and right hand pulls string back close to right cheek. String forms a triangular V from the two bow tips to right hand; ONE arrow continuous from bow arrow-rest to string nock points forward safely into blank studio space. Correct distinct hand and arm functions, elbow/shoulder align, natural tension. Bow and arrow fit entirely within image.

visualQA.reviewer: Codex visual inspection of generated image
visualQA.observations: 前方の手で弓を握り、反対の肘を引いて頬際の弦を支え、一本の矢と張った弦が読める。

label: 弓を引く
